test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

For years, people afflicted with the itchy skin condition used stinky coal tar derivatives to ______ their symptoms.
solution: The correct answer is **"alleviate".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Alleviate"** means to make something less severe or intense. (किसी चीज़ को कम गंभीर या गहन बनाना) • **Example:** *The painkiller helped **alleviate__** the patient's headache.* • It is the most appropriate word in the context of the sentence, as the use of coal tar derivatives is meant to reduce or relieve the symptoms of the itchy skin condition. • So, the correct answer is **option 4**. **Correct sentence**: *For years, people afflicted with the itchy skin condition used stinky coal tar derivatives to __**alleviate**__ their symptoms.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Obviate"**, means to prevent or avoid something. (समस्या का निराकरण करना; निवारण करना) • **"Refer"**, means to mention or direct attention to something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु के विषय में उल्‍लेख या चर्चा करना) • **"Deviate"**, means to depart from a course or direction. (सामान्‍य या प्रत्याशित व्‍यवहार को बदलना या उससे हट कर आचरण करना, लीक से हटना या हटाना, उपयुक्त व्‍यवहार से हटना) 1c7:T6f0, The correct answer is **"No sooner had the ink dried on last week's column, than."**
